object.description: Make a git repository holding the documents DOC and PARENT, and a second copy of it in another folder. Open the first copy in the Project Explorer and open DOC in a Document Editor. Then open the second copy in the same Project Explorer. Expected: the Document Editor on the first copy closes and the Project Explorer lists no open Document Editor; opening DOC again opens a new Document Editor that reads the second copy.
